visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of several flower bouquets resting on a light-colored wooden table. Included are vibrant pink roses with green leaves, delicate white baby's breath, and deep maroon lilies. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the petals and leaves. (2) A pair of hands enters the frame, using a soft white cloth to carefully wipe and polish a translucent yellow crystal sphere and a detailed golden dragon sculpture. The background shows a clean, modern home interior with white walls and furniture. (3) The camera captures a close-up of the golden dragon statue as a hand pours a stream of small, multi-colored, translucent glass beads or crystals into its central basin from a plastic container. The scene maintains high focus on the physical interaction between the hands and objects. (4) The scene transitions to a white shelf where the golden dragon, now filled with colorful gems, is placed prominently. Nearby, other small Buddhist statues, a green potted plant in a white ceramic vase, and a purple amethyst geode are visible in the background. (5) A hand holds a white spray bottle labeled Sea Energe and applies cleaning liquid into the jagged interior of a large purple amethyst geode. A white cloth is then used to wipe the crystal points clean. A small white conch shell rests inside the cave. (6) The camera pans across a high-quality Buddhist thangka painting framed in gold, followed by a sequence showing a red paper talisman with black ink calligraphy. The hands turn the talisman to reveal handwritten signatures on the back. (7) Several dark, dried rose petals are shown being placed onto a black lacquered surface that serves as a small altar or meditation space. A golden incense burner and a small offering bowl are arranged neatly on the shelf. (8) The video concludes with a series of still photographs displayed in a digital montage style, showing the fully cleaned and decorated altar spaces. A golden particle-effect animation appears at the end with the creator's brand logo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic pop background track begins with clear guitar strumming and a light drum beat. The acoustic environment is very clean, resembling a post-produced studio sound. There are no spoken words in this initial segment. (2) The music continues at a steady volume while a female voice begins chanting a repetitive Buddhist mantra in a rhythmic, calm, and soothing manner. High-frequency sounds of small crystals pouring and clinking against a metal surface are clearly audible over the music, triggering a new acoustic phase. (3) The chanting stops and transitions into a narrative monologue by the same female speaker. Her pitch is medium-high, with a friendly and informative tone. Sharp, short bursts of sound from a spray bottle and the soft friction of a cloth are present as she describes the cleaning process. (4) The narration continues as the speaker describes her cleaning ritual, ending with a light, brief laugh. The background music remains consistent in its cheerful mood, eventually fading out as the final brand logo is displayed with a subtle golden shimmer sound effect.
